mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID as id, GROUP_NAME as name FROM TB_GROUP_DEF ORDER BY GROUP_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_GROUP_DEF SET GROUP_NAME = #{name} WHERE GROUP_ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT v.vessel_id AS id, v.vessel_name AS name, v.status AS status, IFNULL(g.group_id, 'NONE') AS groupId FROM TB_VESSEL v LEFT JOIN TB_USER_GROUP g ON v.vessel_id = g.vessel_id AND g.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY v.vessel_name ASC
SELECT user_id AS userId, user_name AS userName, role AS role FROM tb_user WHERE created_by = #{userId}
SELECT vessel_id FROM tb_user_access WHERE user_id = #{targetUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user (user_id, password, user_name, role, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{role}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT MENU_CODE as menuCode, MENU_NAME as menuName, PARENT_CODE as parentCode, DEPTH as depth, MENU_URL as menuUrl, ICON_CLASS as iconClass FROM TB_MENU_CODE WHERE IS_USE = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT TARGET_TYPE, MENU_CODE FROM TB_MENU_CONFIG WHERE (TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND TARGET_ID = #{userId}) OR (TARGET_TYPE = 'ROLE' AND TARGET_ID = #{role})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_MENU_CONFIG WHERE TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MENU_CONFIG (TARGET_ID, TARGET_TYPE, MENU_CODE) VALUES (#{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{menuCode})
mapper.delete: DELETE C FROM TB_MENU_CONFIG C INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON C.TARGET_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE C.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND U.ROLE = #{role}
